_readme: Edit this file to change the products shown on the site. See README.md > 'Editing products'. Fields: id (unique, no spaces), name, category (dice-towers | decor | gaming), description, price (text shown as-is, e.g. "$45" or "From $30"), image (relative path), imageAlt, placeholder (true while the image is a stand-in), featured (true = shown first), buyUrl (optional link to Etsy/Shopify listing; leave "" to show an 'Ask about this' email button instead).
